passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My school is big, and the building is white.
phrases.zh: 我的学校很大，楼是白色的。
phrases.py: wǒ de xué xiào hěn dà， lóu shì bái sè de。

phrases.en: We have a playground, and we have a library too.
phrases.zh: 我们有操场，也有图书馆。
phrases.py: wǒ men yǒu cāo chǎng， yě yǒu tú shū guǎn。

phrases.en: My teacher is there, and my friend is there too.
phrases.ko: 선생님이 거기 있고, 친구도 거기 있어요.
phrases.zh: 我的老师在那里，我的朋友也在那里。
phrases.py: wǒ de lǎo shī zài nà lǐ， wǒ de péng yǒu yě zài nà lǐ。
wǒ ài wǒ de xué xiào。

phrases.en: The big playground is noisy at lunch.
phrases.py: wǔ fàn shí， dà cāo chǎng hěn chǎo。

phrases.en: I walk to school because it is near.
phrases.zh: 学校很近，所以我走着去上学。
phrases.py: xué xiào hěn jìn， suǒ yǐ wǒ zǒu zhe qù shàng xué。

phrases.en: The library is my quiet place in the building.
phrases.ko: 도서관은 건물 안의 나의 조용한 곳이에요.
phrases.zh: 图书馆是楼里我安静的地方。
phrases.py: tú shū guǎn shì lóu lǐ wǒ ān jìng de dì fāng。

phrases.en: A kind teacher and a good friend make school better.
phrases.ko: 친절한 선생님과 좋은 친구는 학교를 더 좋게 해요.
phrases.zh: 善良的老师和好朋友让学校更好。
phrases.py: shàn liáng de lǎo shī hé hǎo péng yǒu ràng xué xiào gèng hǎo。

phrases.en: I love the gate in the morning light.
phrases.ko: 나는 아침 햇살 속의 교문을 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢早晨阳光里的校门。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān zǎo chén yáng guāng lǐ de xiào mén。

phrases.en: This big school is where I learn and play.
phrases.ko: 이 큰 학교는 내가 배우고 노는 곳이에요.
phrases.zh: 这所很大的学校是我学习和玩耍的地方。
phrases.py: zhè suǒ hěn dà de xué xiào shì wǒ xué xí hé wán shuǎ de dì fāng。

full_passage_spoken: My school is big, and the building is white. We have a playground, and we have a library too. I walk through the gate. My teacher is there, and my friend is there too. I love my school. The big playground is noisy at lunch. I walk to school because it is near. The library is my quiet place in the building. A kind teacher and a good friend make school better. I love the gate in the morning light. This big school is where I learn and play.
full_passage_zh: 我的学校很大，楼是白色的。我们有操场，也有图书馆。我走过校门。我的老师在那里，我的朋友也在那里。我爱我的学校。午饭时，大操场很吵。学校很近，所以我走着去上学。图书馆是楼里我安静的地方。善良的老师和好朋友让学校更好。我喜欢早晨阳光里的校门。这所很大的学校是我学习和玩耍的地方。
